description: The Nu River archive combines corrected and original GeoTIFF terrain, MATLAB R2024b LSTM runoff and DDPG operation code, and climate inputs for 18 basins. It addresses 13 planned cascade reservoirs and an SSP245 scenario. This resource is provided by Cheng, Yu; Zhang, Xingxing. Coverage is regional as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. The provider lists MAT, MD, ZIP formats or archive containers, accessible through the linked landing page. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: The reservoirs are planned and the associated manuscript was submitted; neither construction nor paper acceptance is established. For simulation, it can supply inputs or comparison evidence. Related catalogue record: model-hec-ras. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
